blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Over 30 civil society groups across Asia warned that Japan’s $10-billion energy financing drive for Southeast Asian economies could deepen the Philippines’ reliance on fossil fuels despite efforts to accelerate renewables buildout. The organizations said on Friday that pushing for further tie-ups with Japan could make Filipino consumers more vulnerable to oil price volatility and supply disruptions. This scenario has been hounding the global market since the war in the Middle East erupted earlier this year.
